relics.name: Troll Marrow
relics.what: While below half HP, every hit you take knits back 2 per copy.
relics.flavour: It remembers how to grow back — when it must.
relics.passive: Bloodied: heal 2 after every hit taken.

relics.name: Second Stomach
relics.what: Between-floor breathers heal double.
relics.flavour: Always room for one more meal.

relics.name: Bone Chalice
relics.what: Overhealing adds +1 max HP (up to +10 per run).
relics.flavour: It wastes nothing, least of all mercy.

relics.name: Martyr's Knot
relics.what: Heals from relics restore +1 more per copy.
relics.flavour: Tied once, it gives forever.

relics.name: Blood Pact
relics.what: Signing costs 20 HP — and 20% of it again every round in versus; +5 ATK, permanent.
relics.flavour: Sign here. And here. And bleed here.
relics.passive: -20 HP (versus: -20% max HP per round); +5 ATK forever.

relics.name: Gravekeeper's Soil
relics.what: Once per run: refuse death, rise at 25% HP.
relics.flavour: The ground gave you back. Once.
relics.passive: Cheat death once per run (25% HP).

relics.name: Padded Hide
relics.what: +1 DEF; the first hit each fight lands 2 lighter per copy.
relics.flavour: Soft outside. Softer inside.

relics.name: Tower Charm
relics.what: +3 DEF per copy while above 80% HP.
relics.flavour: Tall walls, short memory.

relics.name: Rust Ward
relics.what: +1 DEF; enemy hits land 1 lighter per copy while you're below half HP.
relics.flavour: Old iron protects old wounds.

relics.name: Mirror Scale
relics.what: Critical hits against you are reflected in full.
relics.flavour: See how you like it.

relics.name: Anvil Heart
relics.what: +1 DEF every 10 strikes you land (max +10).
relics.flavour: Every blow forges it harder.
relics.passive: Strikes harden you, blow by blow.

relics.name: Sentinel Bell
relics.what: Each dodge rings +1 DEF for the rest of the floor.
relics.flavour: It rings before the blade arrives.

relics.name: Shell of the Tithe
relics.what: Pays 20 gold at each floor's gate for +4 DEF that floor. Can't pay? It stays shut.
relics.flavour: Protection has a price. It collects.
relics.passive: 20g per floor → +4 DEF; dormant if unpaid.

relics.name: Serrated Fang
relics.what: From your 2nd strike each fight: +1 bleed damage per copy.
relics.flavour: The first cut is just an introduction.

relics.name: Duelist's Oath
relics.what: +4 ATK per copy against bosses, elites and rivals — the oath shatters after 4 floors.
relics.flavour: Sworn hard. Sworn briefly.
relics.passive: +4 ATK vs worthy blood; shatters after 4 floors.

relics.name: Headsman's Notch
relics.what: Every kill notches +1 ATK this floor per copy.
relics.flavour: One line carved for every name.

relics.name: Glass Edge
relics.what: +4 ATK — shatters forever the first time you fall.
relics.flavour: Beautiful, sharp, and honest about it.

relics.name: Sparring Bell
relics.what: Your opening strike each fight hits +2 per copy.
relics.flavour: Round one. Ding.

relics.name: Quenched Blade
relics.what: Every 3rd heal tempers +1 ATK for the rest of the floor.
relics.flavour: Cooled in mercy, swung in anger.

relics.name: Executioner's Coin
relics.what: Once per floor: a strike on an enemy below 20% HP finishes it. In versus: 10% per copy, max 20%.
relics.flavour: Heads, it ends. Tails, it ends.
relics.passive: Execute low foes, once per floor.

relics.name: Wind Anklet
relics.what: +2 SPD per copy.
relics.flavour: It hears the arrow leave the string.

relics.name: Stutterstep
relics.what: Each dodge staggers the enemy: -1 SPD per copy, for the fight.
relics.flavour: They swing where you were.

relics.name: Cavalry Horn
relics.what: Your first attack gauge each fight starts 30% filled.
relics.flavour: The charge answers before the call ends.

relics.name: Momentum Bead
relics.what: Every 3rd strike builds +1 SPD this floor per copy.
relics.flavour: It only rolls downhill.

relics.name: Hare's Drum
relics.what: After a dodge, your next attack comes instantly.
relics.flavour: Its beat skips when yours should.

relics.name: Sprinter's Greaves
relics.what: Fights won in 6 strikes or fewer heal 2 per copy.
relics.flavour: Finish fast, breathe easy.

relics.name: Loaded Horseshoe
relics.what: +5 [[LCK]] per copy; your dodges release luck signals.
relics.flavour: Nailed on backwards, works anyway.

relics.name: Cat's Whisker
relics.what: First dodge each fight: counter for half your ATK.
relics.flavour: It twitched. Someone paid.

relics.name: Fortune's Debt
relics.what: +10 [[LCK]], but gold gains -10%.
relics.flavour: Luck lends. Luck collects.

relics.name: Omen Feather
relics.what: +10 [[LCK]] in boss fights.
relics.flavour: It points at what wants you dead.

relics.name: Gambler's Tooth
relics.what: Your first crit each floor: +8 [[LCK]] that floor.
relics.flavour: Bit down on a miracle once.

relics.name: Trickster's Knot
relics.what: 10% flat chance per copy (max 20%) enemy attacks simply miss.
relics.flavour: The knot unties itself. Elsewhere.

relics.name: Tollkeeper's Ring
relics.what: Every kill pays a +5 gold toll per copy.
relics.flavour: Everyone pays at this gate.

relics.name: Debt of Flesh
relics.what: Every time you spend gold, heal 10. Any spend — rerolls, the bazaar, tolls.
relics.flavour: The body remembers every coin that leaves.

relics.name: Merchant's Thumb
relics.what: Shop wares and draft rerolls cost 20% less.
relics.flavour: It presses the scale, gently.

relics.name: Gilded Thorns
relics.what: Your thorn reflections also shake loose 2 gold per copy.
relics.flavour: Even its cruelty is ornamental.

relics.name: Gilded Plate
relics.what: +1 DEF per 50 gold in the purse. No limit.
relics.flavour: Wealth, worn close.

relics.name: Smuggler's Lining
relics.what: Death recovers 65% of your purse instead of 50%.
relics.flavour: Sewn shut. Mostly.

relics.name: Echo Bead
relics.what: The first relic effect each fight is doubled.
relics.flavour: It answers before you finish asking.

relics.name: Fuse Coil
relics.what: Chains decay gently (×0.75), but the chain cap drops.
relics.flavour: Brighter. Longer. Narrower.

relics.name: Relay Totem
relics.what: Every fight also activates one random relic you carry.
relics.flavour: It passes the message along. Loudly.

relics.name: Spark Jar
relics.what: Catches a fizzled chain; your next strike releases it for 2 damage.
relics.flavour: Nothing wasted. Nothing forgiven.

relics.name: Resonant Skull
relics.what: Deep chains (depth 3+) hum back 1 healing.
relics.flavour: It hums along with the violence.

relics.name: Awakener's Loop
relics.what: Your awakened relics count as three copies.
relics.flavour: One more turn of the screw.

relics.name: Storm Lattice
relics.what: Speed surges arc 1 damage per copy to the enemy.
relics.flavour: The wind here has teeth.

relics.name: Cracked Crown
relics.what: +3 ATK; enemy hits land +1 harder.
relics.flavour: Heavy is the head. And dented.

relics.name: Leech Purse
relics.what: Each of your turns costs 3 gold; when it collects, heal 1 per copy.
relics.flavour: It pays you in your own blood, laundered.

relics.name: Hollow Idol
relics.what: All relic set counts +1; -15 max HP.
relics.flavour: It counts itself among your treasures.

relics.name: Famine Bell
relics.what: Enemies cannot heal; your heals restore 1 less.
relics.flavour: When it rings, every table empties.

relics.name: Millstone Pendant
relics.what: +5 ATK; -5 SPD. The weight swings with you.
relics.flavour: Strength is just weight you agreed to carry.

relics.name: Fortune's Edge
relics.what: Luck signals charge the blade: your next strike hits +50%.
relics.flavour: Chance, honed to a killing angle.

relics.name: Butcher's Tithe
relics.what: Gold gained by relics buys back 1 flesh per copy.
relics.flavour: Every coin weighed in meat.

relics.name: Toll Plate
relics.what: Relic damage mints 1 gold per copy off your armor.
relics.flavour: The plate keeps what the blow paid.

relics.name: Quickened Pulse
relics.what: Luck signals quicken you: +1 SPD per copy for the rest of the floor (round in versus).
relics.flavour: Fortune runs in the veins.

relics.name: Gilt Rot
relics.what: Gold gained by relics decays into a tainted 1-heal per copy.
relics.flavour: Even rot pays rent.

relics.name: Ember Cask
relics.what: Relic damage shakes 1 gold loose per copy.
relics.flavour: Violence, distilled and bottled.

relics.name: Coin Singer
relics.what: Gold gained by relics rings out a lucky note.
relics.flavour: Every coin has a voice. It knows the song.

relics.name: Hex Thread
relics.what: Luck signals lash the foe for 1 per copy.
relics.flavour: Fortune, sharpened to a point.

relics.name: Debtor's Chain
relics.what: +40 gold now; -2 ATK until 60 gold is earned back.
relics.flavour: The links are shaped like promises.
